maps.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production ground-only background for a Chinese fantasy 2D mobile pixel RPG, old salt caravan wilderness.
Create a completely new, exceptionally polished top-down game terrain image, EXACT canvas 960 x 1248 pixels, portrait 10:13 aspect ratio, full bleed, no border.
Style: mature artisan pixel art, coherent 2px pixel clusters at the final resolution, clear restrained cluster shading, no antialiasing or smudgy painting; visually rich but readable, orthographic top-down camera at uniform scale. No perspective horizon, no isometric objects.
Scene: an old sun-bleached salt plain near a dry coastal river. Warm ivory salt crust fractured into irregular natural plates, ochre mineral sand, subdued olive remnants at far edges. The entire central field is open flat walkable ground. A broad diffuse horizontal band of faint wagon wear crosses LEFT TO RIGHT at y=660, blending into surrounding salt flats; it is 220-300 pixels wide with irregular faded margins, no literal outlined trail. The western entrance at (90,660), spawn (160,660), eastern arrival (760,660) and exit (864,660) must all land on clear dry ground. Ground remains clear at (480,500), (625,535), (640,345), (325,985), (550,830), (690,725), (390,910), (570,805), (390,650), (570,715); connect these broadly via open salt/sand terrain.
A shallow dry riverbed depression may occupy only the upper-right outer corner x720-960 y250-430, a subdued flat erosion texture; it must not cut across central traversable ground. Sparse shells, mineral stains, flat pebbles and tiny dry grass tufts restricted to peripheral corners, never tall objects. Intricate salt edges and tonal regions give terrain identity.
CRITICAL: GROUND ONLY. Do NOT bake in salt carts, bridge ruins, cairns, vertical boulders, dead trees, bones, signposts, buildings, barrels, people, enemies, labels, text, UI, coins, icons, target markers, grids, shadows of unseen objects. Interactive objects will be separately placed by the engine. No narrow winding road, no vertical road, no branching noodle paths, no geometric repeated tile texture, no fake holes in walkable areas.
Use soft midday directional consistency, creamy ivory and warm clay mineral palette. It must look like premium final game terrain art, not a concept illustration or a diagram.
must_preserve_dynamic_layers: 所有existing quest entities（salt_cart_ledger等），出生、出口与交互碰撞逻辑
recommended_remove_static_layers: SaltRoadGround所有静态干河床、残桥和白圈绘制（地表已完整；新图无桥烘焙）
随机地面散件/噪声叠色；地表tint应ffffff
maps.layout_notes: 整片开阔盐壳荒原。东西向y660宽磨损带。没有旧纵向弯路，所有交互点可站立。

Soft restrained late-morning lighting. Weathered warm gray limestone, muted ocher wood, deep teal coastal water with measured little wave accents. Ground should have detail at several scales but unobtrusive underneath characters.
Geometry in FINAL pixel coordinates: main wide stone harbor quay runs north-south from y0 to1248 between x300 and660; its open 150px-wide center x405..555 is entirely free of obstacles. Connect western edge to center by a broad horizontal wooden causeway x0..420 y620..710, and center to east edge by a broad wooden causeway x540..960 y655..745; their endpoints (90,660),(210,660),(760,700),(864,700) remain clearly dry walkable deck. North entrance (480,96),(480,190) remains stone clear.

maps.prompt:

Asset type: production ground-only terrain background, Tide-mark Shoal, for a premium 2D Chinese fantasy mobile pixel RPG.

Critical desired change: REMOVE EVERY drawn little path and narrow winding route from the old image. Replace the entire old branching dark noodle-road system with broad continuous naturally rippled walkable wet sand. Sand wear is diffuse tonal variation rather than distinct roads. No outlines tracing where the old roads were.
Art direction: mature crisp hand-authored pixel terrain, consistent 2px pixel clusters at final resolution, orthographic overhead, no camera perspective. Warm muted wet beige sand with pale salt crust accents, olive-beige edge grasses, blue-green clear rock pools, deep teal sea on the right edge. Restrained richer detail in tidal rim edges, rippled sand forms and sea foam; quiet central playfield, coherent cluster shading. Match polished artisan game terrain rather than a tiny 16bit tileset, photoreal texture or flat geometric sketch.
TOPOLOGY in 960x1248 coordinates: unobstructed open sand is dominant from x180..810, y145..1248. Broad clear access from western map edge at y640..760 to central sandy field. Small flat wooden landing x0..78 y660..730 leads into sand at the west edge. Keep western exit (90,700) and spawn (165,700) clearly on dry accessible ground. Northern entrance remains open at x415..545 y0..210 with exit (480,96) and spawn (480,200) clear; the northern top corners may be flat old gray coastal stone pavement, not a tall blocking wall or roof.
Preserve FIVE irregular shallow WATER POOLS with positions and extents very close to original: oval pools at center (220,310) size150x65; (700,300) size175x80; (300,495) size205x90; (720,790) size170x75; (650,1140) size195x75. Existing separate ships, driftwood, rocks, crab pots, net rack, posts and gauges will be placed by game engine; keep their sites clear and DO NOT paint them into terrain.
Leave open sand around all gameplay points (410,700),(310,560),(625,850),(580,380),(585,1015),(480,390),(480,810),(750,665),(390,970),(570,790),(390,610),(570,900),(580,1000),(390,900),(580,740),(390,1060),(390,1020),(580,1040).
No boats, trees, boulders, vertical rocks, stumps, signs, stakes, buildings, cart wheels, cargo, crates, debris, people, monsters, text, UI, markers, symbols, grids, or overly deep trenches. Terrain only. No baked vertical obstacles in sand.

maps.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: production ground-only background for Tide-receding Sluice boss puzzle in a premium 2D Chinese fantasy mobile pixel RPG.
Input image1 is the EXACT LEVEL GEOMETRY GUIDE. Preserve its pixel-relative land/water regions and proportions precisely; replace flat guide fills with superb final pixel art. Input image2 is STYLE REFERENCE for artisan stone and teal coastal water only; do not import its wooden docks or its buildings platform layout.
Output exactly 960x1248 pixels portrait 10:13, orthographic overhead, no perspective, full bleed. Coherent 2px clusters, crisp mature premium pixel art and artfully arranged texture variation; weathered gray-green ancient hydraulic masonry and deep desaturated teal water, warm small limestone highlights, sparse dark moss.
Exact geometry: CENTRAL WALKABLE STONE DECK x330..630 spans the ENTIRE image height y0..1248. It is a continuous wide 300px stone hydraulic structure, not a drawn narrow dirt path. BOTH OUTER SIDES x0..329 and x630..959 are DEEP WATER CANALS throughout the whole image. Match these long straight stone-water boundary lines to the guide (x330 and630). The playfield x350..610 must remain entirely clear and flat. No stone floor or stepping stones beyond the edges to imply players can walk into water. No hidden third bank.
Render central ground as spacious old sluice maintenance terraces with irregular large stone slab groupings, quiet paving wear, a few dark algae stains and shallow erosion at outer edge. Indicate three connected functional terrace sections subtly via stone slab orientation around y485 and y770, with no raised partitions. Do NOT paint repeated 48px grid or hard dark tile outlines. No narrower pill-shaped lane inside the walkway, no outlined roads. Outer masonry rims at x330..349 and610..629 are low flush surface edging, never tall walls or railing, because actors must see and approach the bank.
Critical reserved gameplay zones: entrance/spawn/exit at (480,1050),(480,1152), clue record (480,870), boss footprint around (480,410). Interaction controls (310,690),(650,535),(310,590) will be independently drawn by engine on the edges; do not bake them in. Existing engine dynamically floods or dries the CENTER floor across rectangle x350..610 y485..548 and changes water states along both canals below y750 or900. Therefore image must show dry stone under the entire central rectangle; no permanent crossing water, holes, fences or gates. Horizontal gates at y475 and770 remain dynamic game objects. Supplies around (408,625) and(555,625) also remain separate objects.
Canal surface: gentle flat top-down tide ripples, nuanced underwater stone and silt near edges; deep teal far out, sparse pale foam. Any side ornamental hydraulic stonework must stay fully beyond x0 or960, not intrude. No dam towers, bridges spanning the canals, chains, wheels, gate beams, railings, statues, pillars, crates, cargo, sacks, boats, buildings, signposts, ladders, people, enemies, text, labels, icons, UI or markers. NO tall or solid objects are baked into the walkable floor. Map visual must match actual physical boundaries exactly.
must_preserve_dynamic_layers: 所有独立解谜实体和首领
recommended_remove_static_layers: TidalGateGround静态water tiled源纹理、固定双岸水平线
x332/x610的固定直条岸墙（新地表已烘焙）
